claims.summary: A fresh deployed v0.15.122 UX audit exported 98/100 with clean sources/export/enrichment truth but one lesson-plan prompt-artifact P1.
Lesson-plan compilation treats colon-labeled assessment artifacts such as Discussion prompts: Usability testing as unsafe prose references.
Stale modality text is sanitized so instructor notes no longer preserve prompt-labeled assessment strings as evidence concepts.
Prompt-artifact focus/check findings now require nearby labels, preventing distant DOCX headers from creating false positives while preserving true nearby artifact-label findings.
The release explicitly requires a fresh deployed v0.15.123 ZIP/log audit before claiming provider output is clean.

knownRemainingTargets: Fresh deployed v0.15.123 ZIP/log audit must prove real UX provider output no longer exports colon-labeled prompt artifacts in lesson-plan DOCX files.
Fresh deployed output must prove Texture reaches 100/100 or identify the next concrete repeated shingle.
Every exported surface must agree: UI, ZIP, manifest, quality report, source report, digest logs, DOCX/PPTX files, and local regrade.
